mapper.sql: select id, food_id, food_name, type, quantity, before_qty, after_qty, unit, operator, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from stock_record
mapper.insert: insert into stock_record ( id, food_id, food_name, type, quantity, before_qty, after_qty, unit, operator, create_time ) values ( #{id}, #{foodId}, #{foodName}, #{type}, #{quantity}, #{beforeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{unit}, #{operator}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete:
delete from stock_record where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from food_stock where deleted = 0) as kinds, (select count(*) from food_stock where deleted = 0 and quantity < warn_line) as warnCount, ifnull(sum(case when type = 'IN' and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as monthInTimes, ifnull(sum(case when type = 'IN' and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m') then quantity else 0 end), 0) as monthInQty, ifnull(sum(case when type = 'OUT' and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as monthOutTimes, ifnull(sum(case when type = 'OUT' and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m') then quantity else 0 end), 0) as monthOutQty from stock_record
